description: Use this when the person asks where the chip is in a passport or ID card, or why their iPhone does not read it. Give the country as a two-letter code or its English name. Not for whether a document is genuine: only the Superpass app reads and checks a chip. Answers where the chip is in that country's passport and how to hold an iPhone to read it, the older design if one is still valid, whether its ID card has a chip an iPhone reads and what opens it, the source the answer comes from and how sure it is, and the page on superpass.me.

country.description: a two-letter code (de) or the English name (Germany)

name: get_chip_location
title: Get where the chip is
